_comment: Three seeds of one full-body side-view character with Pro Flash, shown as a numbered contact sheet for the user to pick the canonical still. The look words, sprite size and optional style anchor come from the project style.
_comment_prompt: /pixellab-pip run the character-candidates blueprint for a hooded ranger with a longbow

TASK.instruction: Before any PixelLab call, require an explicit current-user request to run this blueprint, confirm an authenticated PixelLab MCP connection, and create the declared output directory empty (lowest free -2 suffix if taken). Resolve look, sprite width/height and optional family anchor from the current request and any applicable project style (references/project-style.md); no profile requires no setup. Resolve only missing consequential variables. This explicit blueprint requests three candidates; ordinary character requests still start with one. Resolve style anchor to {"url": <anchor URL>, "usage_description": "match this sprite's outline weight, pixel detail, shading and palette"} when the style names an anchor, else null. Write the character description per references/characters.md (body plan, every carried prop and which hand holds it, worn-side gear in visible terms). Width and height must be multiples of 4 from 16 to 256. Resolve current-request overrides before execution; the blueprint is a recipe, not permission. Follow the canonical approval and content-review contracts in references/auto.md and references/reviewable-candidates.md. The user must accept any proposed local pixel/playback transformations separately from spending approval.
TASK.verify: The run is approved, MCP is authenticated, every variable is resolved, and the output directory is new and empty.

MCP create_image_pro_flash.description: full body {{character description}} standing, facing {{facing | default: right}}, {{project style look words}}, whole body fits inside the canvas with a small margin

TASK.instruction: Poll MCP get_image for each of the three jobs returned by the preceding calls until completed or failed; re-poll on transient errors and never resubmit. Save each image unchanged as candidate-1.png through candidate-3.png in call order. Build candidates.png with assets/contact_sheet.py at 3x, numbered from 1, and run the look checklist in references/characters.md on each. Present every candidate with its look result per references/reviewable-candidates.md and follow its selection/delegation rule; save the chosen one unchanged as character.png. The chosen still is this character's source only; do not persist it as a project family anchor without a separate deliberate save request.
TASK.verify: Three transparent candidates at the requested size match their returned payloads, candidates.png shows each once with labels 1-3, and character.png is byte-identical to the candidate chosen under that selection/delegation rule.
